name: AXM Geographic Market Map
summary: Map traceable price, material, availability and popularity evidence across the Netherlands, Croatia and the EU, with review-gated imports, quality diagnostics, pattern candidates, Top 100/Top 10 rankings and a human watchlist.
notes: One visible tool on the modular Workshop base. Automated source adapters for Eurostat, CBS, Croatian DZS, UN Comtrade and World Bank are catalogued but not claimed as built. Pattern cards are research questions, Quality Signal is diagnostic, and no buy/sell instruction or trade execution is produced.
